note: Derived from the public SuperDex shape_box collision meshes. Box frame = body frame (origin at the bottom centre, z up). Each hole: the face's outward normal n, in-plane axes (u, v), the mid-wall plane at n.x = plane_offset (wall spans inner..outer along n), and the hole outline in (u, v) box-frame coordinates sampled on that plane. Each piece (piece frame = its SuperDex actor frame): centroid, the matching hole id, and up to 64 convex-hull points used by the scoring rule.
